info.title: SNA SDK API
info.description: Skills-Native Application SDK — HTTP API for spawning and communicating with AI agent providers (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode).

get.description: Verify the SNA server is running.
Return the dynamically allocated SNA API port.

post.description: Create an agent session record without starting a process.

delete.description: Remove an agent session, its history, runtime chain, and pending permission request.

patch.description: Update session metadata: label, meta, and cwd.

post.description: Start an agent process inside a session.
Send a message to the active agent. Images are supported.

400.description: No active session or empty message.

post.description: Resume a session with database history injected.
Change the model for a live session.
Change permission mode for a live session.

patch.description: Apply a unified session config patch.

400.description: Session has no active runtime, or respawn failed.

post.description: Kill the agent process while preserving the session record.
Run one temporary agent execution and return the final result.
Run one temporary execution and stream AgentEvent objects over SSE.

200.description: Open SSE stream. Each `data:` line is a JSON-encoded AgentEvent (assistant, assistant_delta, tool_use, tool_use_delta, complete, error, ...). The connection closes after the terminal event.

schema.description: SSE feed of AgentEvent objects, one per `data:` line.

post.description: Run a lightweight one-shot LLM completion without session management.

200.description: Completion result with usage and cost.

post.description: Inspect available models for a provider runtime.

get.description: Stream session AgentEvent objects over Server-Sent Events.

schema.description: Cursor to resume from. Omit to start at the current head.

parameters.description: Cursor to resume from. Omit to start at the current head.
parameters.name: since

200.description: An open SSE stream. The response body is `text/event-stream`.

schema.description: SSE stream. Each `data:` line is a JSON-encoded AgentEvent.

post.description: Submit a permission request and wait for a decision.
Approve or deny a pending permission request.
